module: 改动文档M2-三盘独立与真实星盘
isolation: New anonymous Playwright contexts against dedicated QA loopback 8881; no user-preview browser or database used. No business source was modified by the probe.

probe.method: Existing stage3 loaded in memory with observational helper-read/RAF/toggle logs. No render or disclosure behavior replaced. Two bounded contexts; trial0 passed, trial1 reproduced.
probe.failure: openNatalDetails .lcb-pillars waitFor visible timed out after 5000ms; native disclosure was closed.

diagnosis: The helper read the rebuilt default-closed disclosure before restoration. RAF restored the saved open=true before the native click, so the click based on the earlier false observation closed it. The later visible-table wait cannot fix this reversed click. This confirms the read/restore/input ordering race, rather than a guessed click-open then false-restore sequence.
scopeLimit: A separate stable archive-open then resize probe stayed open; the current resize listener is gated on visible rails. That probe does not prove a universal archive-resize regression.
